scripts.verify: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && turbo build lint type-check
scripts.db:reset: docker compose --profile dev down -v && docker compose --profile dev up -d
scripts.db:setup: docker compose --profile dev up -d --wait postgres && pnpm --filter api db:migrate
scripts.docker:prod: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.prod.yml --profile full up -d --build
scripts.docker:prod:down: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.prod.yml --profile full down
